entries.mitigation: The targeted player moves away until the growing blast circle no longer overlaps teammates.
Block the heavy attack to avoid the knockdown and large burst of damage.

entries.entry_name: Storm Flurry — Kra'gh the Dreugh King
entries.mitigation: Block or strongly mitigate the multi-hit flurry instead of taking the full sequence.

entries.entry_name: Lightning Field — Kra'gh the Dreugh King
entries.mitigation: Move out of the lightning field immediately, then return once the field resolves.
Tank or chain spiders into the boss for cleave and interrupt spiders that attempt to feed.
Stay close to limit long leaps; block or dodge the leap and restack immediately.
Recover from the center pull and immediately prepare for the boss's follow-up burst.
Maintain personal spacing and move out from the boss center after the pull so the explosion does not punish the group.
Kill the low-health clone immediately before duplicate boss pressure builds.
Stay close to Shadowrend; if Devour triggers, interrupt it immediately to free the targeted player.
Kill healing orbs before they reach Rilis and restore his health.
Step out of each ground-fire pool without dragging the boss around the room.
Block the heavy attack; unblocked hits can be lethal to non-tanks.
Move out of the poison ground effect immediately; do not try to finish a cast while standing in it.
Cleave or focus each Kwama wave as it appears so adds do not accumulate across health thresholds.
Keep the boss faced away from the group and block the frontal smash.
Bash the Hive Lord promptly to stop the repeating group-wide pound.
Keep the Sentinel out of healing spheres and clear spider pressure if the room begins to fill.
The targeted player kites the spinning boss until the chase ends; everyone else stays clear of its path.
Move out of incoming lightning impacts and avoid lingering in the resulting fields.
The tank blocks and keeps Akash facing away from the group so the frontal cone never clips allies.
Step out of the close-range spin and be ready to block the heavy attack that commonly follows.
Stay reasonably close to Chokethorn so the long-range chain pull does not trigger unnecessarily.
Leave the large expanding AOE before it resolves, then move back in after the burst disappears.
Watch Oraneth turn toward her chosen target and dodge roll as the channeled poison bolt is released.
Move out of the growing AOE before it resolves, then return to your assigned position.
Tank or pull the skeletons onto the boss and clear them with AOE before their heavy attacks create side pressure.
Stay away from the roaming green hazards and never kite one through the group.
Tank the summoned ghosts and burn them down promptly before ranged add pressure stacks up.
Sidestep the long frontal attack and keep healers and ranged damage dealers out of its line.
When Varaine jumps, move or dodge roll out of melee range before the spinning sword attack lands.
Block Allene's heavy attack; letting it land unblocked can cause a large burst even on the tank.
When Allene vanishes, immediately switch to the hallucinations and kill them quickly before she returns.
